title: Collection and preprocessing of fine needle aspirate patient samples for single cell profiling
author: Tastanova, Ramelyte, et al.
materials: Human primary cutaneous lymphoma fine-needle aspirates
Chromium Single Cell V(D)J Reagent Kits

steps.title: Set up syringe holder and needle
steps.instruction: Assemble the syringe holder, syringe, and needle for FNA collection.

substeps.instruction: Select a holder (e.g., Pistomed, MED1000522, medesign, Dietramszell - Linden, Germany).
Fit a 20 mL syringe into the holder.
Attach a G23 needle to the syringe.

steps.title: Gather disinfecting wipes and bandage
steps.instruction: Prepare disinfecting wipes and a bandage for the procedure.

steps.title: Prepare cryovial with freezing medium
steps.instruction: Fill a 1 mL cryovial with slow‑freezing medium (90 % FBS, 10 % DMSO) and place it on ice.

steps.title: Pre‑cool cryo container
steps.instruction: Cool the cryo storage container before use.

substeps.instruction: Place the CoolCell LX (BioCision, BCS‑405G, Corning, Inc.) in a freezer to pre‑cool.
Alternative: use a Mr. Frosty cooling container (Cat.#5100-0001, NALGENETM Cryo).

steps.title: Warm water bath to 37 °C
steps.instruction: Set the water bath temperature to 37 °C for rapid thawing of cryopreserved samples if needed.

steps.title: Prepare cold PBS with BSA
steps.instruction: Make cold Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺‑free PBS containing 0.04 % BSA and keep it on ice.

substeps.instruction: Use PBS (Gibco, Cat.#10010-015) and add filter‑sterilized BSA to a final concentration of 0.04 %.

steps.title: Label collection tubes
steps.instruction: Label 5 mL Eppendorf tubes or 15 mL centrifuge tubes with sample names/IDs.

substeps.instruction: Use 5 mL Eppendorf tubes (Eppendorf, Cat.#0030122313) or 15 mL tubes (TPP, Cat.#91015).

steps.title: Prepare and label FACS tubes
steps.instruction: Label FACS tubes and attach blue filter caps (35 μm).

substeps.instruction: Use caps (filter size 35 μm, Cat.#352235, Falcon).

steps.title: Prepare dead‑cell removal medium
steps.instruction: Make PBS‑based medium with 1 % FBS and 1 mM CaCl₂ for low‑viability samples.

substeps.instruction: Combine Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺‑free PBS (Gibco, Cat.#10010-015) with 1 % FBS (Cat.#S006420E01, Biowest) and 1 mM CaCl₂ (Cat.#746495, Sigma Aldrich).

steps.title: Prepare red blood cell lysis solution
steps.instruction: Ready the red blood cell lysis reagent for samples containing erythrocytes.

steps.title: Optional: Prepare dry ice for samples
steps.instruction: Set aside dry ice to keep cryopreserved samples cold until processing.

description: The protocol below outlines preparation steps for fine needle aspirate collection (FNA) and its preprocessing for single cell RNA sequencing on cutaneous cancer lesions. We have performed the FNA sampling on cutaneous B cell lymphoma and cutaneous melanoma metastases. This section describes how to collect FNA samples from cutaneous cancers and cryopreserve using a slow-freezing procedure, as well as preprocess the cryopreserved or freshly sampled FNA sample for single cell RNA-seq processing and single-cell data analysis tools.
